reasons: The publication reports 1.0 wt% Pd but does not identify the denominator.
For 1.0 g PMS the reported 5.0 mL liquid is 4.31 times the 1.16 mL nominal pore-volume product, despite the incipient-wetness label.

The reported 0.030 g Pd(acac)2 corresponds to 1.0480 wt% Pd/support or 1.0371 wt% Pd/(support + retained Pd) with ImpregCalc atomic weights, so it is consistent with a rounded 1.0 wt% statement but does not resolve the convention.
entries.software_action: No parser or scientific-core change. Pd(acac)2 is normalized outside the core to C10H14O4Pd using PubChem CID 5486778, and both denominator scenarios are reported.
